### Move results

quarto renders our documents in a file structure relativ to where the quarto document is in the project. This workaround moves the fils to the results folder and deletes the R sub folder.

```{r}
#| label: move-results
output_dir <- here("results", 
                   "R")

if (dir.exists(output_dir)) {

  files <- list.files(output_dir, 
                      full.names = TRUE)

  file.rename(
    from = files,
    to = file.path(here("results"), 
                   basename(files)))

  unlink(output_dir,
         recursive = TRUE)
}
```
